observation_format.evidence_quote: debugging begins with HLS simulation and syn- thesis log parsing, which uses keyword matching to extract error messages.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Operating under strict instruction adherence, this agent adopts the instructions to implement debugging.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the architecture comprises two primary phases: HLS-C generation and HLS-C debugging.
